about.title: About Me
about.intro: I am a Software Engineer specialised in
about.highlight1: backend development and enterprise systems integration
about.intro2: for banking, insurance and capital markets: Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, Apache Camel and Enterprise Integration Patterns, asynchronous messaging and AWS environments.

vermeg_backend.title: Software Engineer, Backend & Integration
vermeg_backend.location: Tunis, Tunisia · Permanent · On-site assignments in Paris
description: Designed and developed 30+ REST APIs using Java 11 and Spring Boot for the subscription journeys of a leading European insurer (property and casualty, machinery breakdown, health, garage).
Developed integration and orchestration layers using Apache Camel and Enterprise Integration Patterns to connect heterogeneous business systems.
Contributed to a centralised integration platform acting as a broker between financial systems.
Implemented the FIX protocol using QuickFIX/J and integrated Bloomberg connectivity for custody systems and market data providers.
Developed asynchronous messaging flows using JMS, ActiveMQ, RabbitMQ and AWS SQS, including Data Lake ingestion; built an Isabel banking connector.
Contributed to 50+ releases (feature updates and patches) and participated in two major production deployment operations: preparation, Go/No-Go, deployment and hypercare.
Resolved 200+ tickets covering feature requests, defects and production incidents, from troubleshooting to fixes.
Worked with AWS, Docker, Kubernetes and Argo CD; Jenkins and GitLab CI pipelines; Maven and Nexus.
Use Cursor, GitHub Copilot and Claude day to day; contributed to an internal R&D initiative on generative AI in integration platforms.
Collaborated with international teams and European clients; mentored and onboarded junior developers.
